files.name: nightly-export.yaml
files.text:
name: nightly-export
description: Exports the day's orders to the harbor bucket.
project: harbor
schedule: "0 2 * * *"
params:
  bucket: harbor-exports
  since: 1d
steps:
  - id: fetch
    kind: fetch
    with:
      url: https://api.example.org/orders?since=${params.since}
      format: json
  - id: transform
    kind: transform
    needs: [fetch]
    with:
      language: jq
      script: '.orders | map({id, total, email: .customer.email})'
  - id: validate
    kind: validate
    needs: [transform]
    with:
      rules:
        - field: email
          check: email
        - field: total
          check: positive
      on_invalid: fail
      max_rejected: 10
  - id: upload
    kind: upload
    needs: [validate]
    retries: 2
    with:
      bucket: ${params.bucket}
      path: orders/${run.date}.json
  - id: notify
    kind: notify
    needs: [upload]
    with:
      channel: "#harbor"
      on: [failed]
      message: "nightly-export wrote ${steps.validate.rows} orders"

files.name: import-orders.yaml
files.text:
name: import-orders
description: Takes in the order files dropped every half hour.
project: harbor
schedule: "*/30 * * * *"
steps:
  - id: fetch
    kind: fetch
    with:
      url: https://files.example.org/orders/latest.csv
      format: csv
  - id: validate
    kind: validate
    needs: [fetch]
    with:
      rules:
        - field: id
          check: unique
        - field: placed_at
          check: date
      on_invalid: skip
  - id: upload
    kind: upload
    needs: [validate]
    with:
      bucket: harbor-orders
      path: incoming/${run.id}.csv

failed-runs.sql
files.text:
-- The failed steps of every run, newest first
SELECT r.id, r.pipeline, s.step, s.duration_ms, r.started_at
FROM runs r
JOIN steps s ON s.run_id = r.id
WHERE r.state = 'failed' AND s.state = 'failed'
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
LIMIT 50

files.name: sync-inventory.yaml
files.text:
name: sync-inventory
description: Copies the stock counts from the warehouse every hour.
project: juniper
schedule: "0 * * * *"
params:
  warehouse: north
steps:
  - id: fetch
    kind: fetch
    with:
      url: https://warehouse.example.org/${params.warehouse}/stock
      format: ndjson
      since: 1h
  - id: transform
    kind: transform
    needs: [fetch]
    with:
      language: sql
      script: SELECT sku, sum(count) AS count FROM rows GROUP BY sku
  - id: upload
    kind: upload
    needs: [transform]
    with:
      bucket: juniper-stock
      path: stock/${run.date}.ndjson
      overwrite: true

files.name: rebuild-index.yaml
files.text:
name: rebuild-index
description: Rebuilds the search index from the catalog every Sunday.
project: juniper
schedule: "0 4 * * 0"
params:
  catalog: https://catalog.example.org/items
steps:
  - id: fetch
    kind: fetch
    with:
      url: ${params.catalog}
      format: json
  - id: transform
    kind: transform
    needs: [fetch]
    retries: 9
    with:
      script: '.items | map({sku, title, words: (.title | ascii_downcase | split(" "))})'
  - id: upload
    kind: upload
    needs: [transform]
    with:
      bucket: juniper-search
      path: index/${params.index}.json
  - id: notify
    kind: notify
    needs: [upload]
    with:
      channel: "#juniper"
      on: [failed, succeeded]

files.name: slow-steps.sql
files.text:
-- How long each step takes, slowest first
SELECT step, count(*) AS runs, round(avg(duration_ms)) AS avg_ms, max(duration_ms) AS max_ms
FROM steps
WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY step
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC

files.name: send-digest.yaml
files.text:
name: send-digest
description: Sends the weekday digest of new items.
project: larkspur
schedule: "0 8 * * 1-5"
steps:
  - id: fetch
    kind: fetch
    with:
      url: https://feeds.example.org/larkspur/new
  - id: transform
    kind: transform
    needs: [fetch]
    with:
      script: '.entries | sort_by(.published) | reverse | .[:20]'
  - id: upload
    kind: upload
    needs: [transform]
    with:
      bucket: larkspur-digests
      path: digest/${run.date}.json
  - id: notify
    kind: notify
    needs: [transform]
    with:
      channel: "#larkspur"
      on: [succeeded, failed]
      message: "Today's digest has ${steps.transform.rows} new items"

JOIN jobs j ON j.name = r.pipeline
GROUP BY j.owner, r.state
ORDER BY j.owner, runs DESC

name.description: The pipeline's name, lowercase with dashes, as runs list it.

description.description: What the pipeline is for, in a sentence.

project.description: The project whose buckets and channels it uses.

schedule.description: When it runs by itself: a cron line of five fields, such as "0 2 * * *" for 02:00 every day.

steps.description: The steps, each after the steps it needs.

id.description: The step's name in this pipeline, which needs and references use.

kind.description: What the step does; its kind decides what goes in with.

needs.description: The steps that finish before this one starts.

retries.description: How many times a failed try is tried again, up to 5.

timeout.description: How long one try may take: 30s, 10m, 1h.

with.description: The step's settings, which its kind decides.

url.description: Where the rows are read from, over https.

since.description: Only rows changed since this long ago, such as 1d.

language.description: The language the script is written in.

script.description: What makes the new rows from the rows given.

on_invalid.description: What refused rows do: fail the run past max_rejected, be left out, or pass with a warning.

max_rejected.description: How many refused rows fail allows before it fails.

path.description: Where in the bucket, such as orders/${run.date}.json.

overwrite.description: Whether a file already there is replaced.

channel.description: The channel posted to, such as #harbor.

message.description: What is posted; references are filled in.

name: nightly-export
description: Exports the day's orders to the harbor bucket.
project: harbor
schedule: "0 2 * * *"
params:
  bucket: harbor-exports
  since: 1d
steps:
  - id: fetch
    kind: fetch
    with:
      url: https://api.example.org/orders?since=${params.since}
      format: json
  - id: transform
    kind: transform
    needs: [fetch]
    with:
      language: jq
      script: '.orders | map({id, total, email: .customer.email})'
  - id: validate
    kind: validate
    needs: [transform]
    with:
      rules:
        - field: email
          check: email
        - field: total
          check: positive
      on_invalid: fail
      max_rejected: 10
  - id: upload
    kind: upload
    needs: [validate]
    retries: 2
    with:
      bucket: ${params.bucket}
      path: orders/${run.date}.json
  - id: notify-2
    kind: notify
    needs: [upload]
    with:
      channel: "#alerts"
      on: [failed]
  - id: notify
    kind: notify
    needs: [upload]
    with:
      channel: "#harbor"
      on: [failed]
      message: "nightly-export wrote ${steps.validate.rows} orders"

description: Sends the weekday digest of new items.
project: larkspur
schedule: "0 8 * * 1-5"
steps:
  - id: fetch
    kind: fetch
    with:
      url: https://feeds.example.org/larkspur/new
  - id: transform
    kind: transform
    needs: [fetch]
    with:
      script: '.entries | sort_by(.published) | reverse | .[:20]'
  - id: upload
    kind: upload
    needs: [transform]
    with:
      bucket: larkspur-digests
      path: digest/${run.date}.json
  - id: notify
    kind: notify
    needs: [transform]
    with:
      channel: "#larkspur"
      on: [succeeded, failed, cancelled]
      message: "Today's digest has ${steps.transform.rows} new items"

name: nightly-export
description: Exports the day's orders to the harbor bucket.
project: harbor
schedule: "0 2 * * *"
params:
  bucket: harbor-exports
  since: 1d
steps:
  - id: fetch
    kind: fetch
    with:
      url: https://api.example.org/orders?since=${params.since}
      format: json
  - id: transform
    kind: transform
    needs: [fetch]
    with:
      language: jq
      script: '.orders | map({id, total, email: .customer.email})'
  - id: validate
    kind: validate
    needs: [transform]
    with:
      rules:
        - field: email
          check: email
      on_invalid: warn
      max_rejected: 10
  - id: upload
    kind: upload
    needs: [validate]
    retries: 2
    with:
      bucket: ${params.bucket}
      path: orders/${run.date}.json
  - id: notify
    kind: notify
    needs: [upload]
    with:
      channel: "#harbor"
      on: [failed]
      message: "nightly-export wrote ${steps.validate.rows} orders"

name: rebuild-index
description: Rebuilds the search index from the catalog every Sunday.
project: juniper
schedule: "0 4 * * 0"
params:
  catalog: https://catalog.example.org/items
steps:
  - id: fetch
    kind: fetch
    with:
      url: ${params.catalog}
      format: json
  - id: transform
    kind: transform
    needs: [fetch]
  - id: upload
    kind: upload
    needs: [transform]
    with:
      bucket: juniper-search
      path: index/${params.index}.json
  - id: notify
    kind: notify
    needs: [upload]
    with:
      channel: "#juniper"
      on: [failed, succeeded]

name: import-orders
description: Takes in the order files dropped every half hour.
project: harbor
schedule: "*/30 * * * *"
steps:
  - id: fetch
    kind: fetch
    with:
      url: https://files.example.org/orders/latest.csv
      format: csv
  - id: validate
    kind: validate
    needs: [fetch]
    with:
      rules:
        - field: id
          check: unique
        - field: placed_at
          check: date
      on_invalid: skip
  - id: upload
    kind: upload
    needs: [validate]
    retries: 1
    note: "10"
    labels: [a, b]
    matrix:
      - [1, 2]
      - [3]
    with:
      bucket: harbor-orders
      path: incoming/${run.id}.csv

name: sync-inventory
description: Copies the stock counts from the warehouse every hour.
project: juniper
schedule: "0 * * * *"
params:
  warehouse: north
steps:
  - id: fetch
    kind: fetch
    with:
      url: https://warehouse.example.org/${params.warehouse}/stock
      format: ndjson
      since: 2h
  - id: transform
    kind: transform
    needs: [fetch]
    with:
      language: sql
      script: SELECT sku, sum(count) AS count FROM rows GROUP BY sku
  - id: upload
    kind: upload
    needs: [transform]
    with:
      bucket: juniper-stock
      path: stock/${run.date}.ndjson
      overwrite: true

afterRuns.source:
-- How long each step takes, slowest first
SELECT step, count(*) AS runs, round(avg(duration_ms)) AS avg_ms, max(duration_ms) AS max_ms
FROM steps
WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY step
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC
